title: Behind the Presses
style: Close and spoken, one person on a bad phone line, as episode 1. Asides in her normal voice, a little lower, never whispered: they are rendered with no tag and listed under asides, so the mix lowers them (Henric 29/10). Muffled lines carry no tag either: the app muffles them. Written in English 2026-10-30 from the Swedish draft 5 and the core loop of 30/10, recorded the same day. One clip per manuscript line, so the directing desk sets every pause.

voiceNotes.vega: Jessica, Soft and Demure (American, a professional clone), eleven_v4, stability 0.3, no overall tag (Henric 2026-10-29: 'Som provet'). Her recording carries a hiss, taken by the local filter (denoise: render_glimt.py DENOISE, Henric's nr=12).
voiceNotes.snackan: Rowan (British, his own accent), eleven_v3, no tags, stability 1.0 so it stays flat (Henric 2026-10-26). Played through the earpiece filter named under snackaFilter (glimt/herside.js).

lines.s0-1: Static. Just static. [pause] There. Yes. There.
lines.s0-2: There you are. I'd know that shape anywhere.
lines.s0-3: You came back. I said I'd manage, and I did. [dry] It wasn't as much fun.
lines.s0-dark: It's dark where you are. I'm looking for a star. [pause] I only get a bit of your sky. Not enough. Not yet.
lines.s0-susp: It got logged, the thing at the bell. They asked me about it. Twice. I said I had a stone in my shoe, and they wanted to see the shoe. [pause] It was empty. That was the problem.
lines.s0-nosusp: Nobody's asked me anything. I'm almost a little hurt.
lines.s0-d2: I'd only just gotten in. I was standing inside the door thinking, that's it for tonight. And you just keep going.
lines.s0-d3: Then I'm going back out. The loop's closed. But if you can't sleep, you get one more round. [dry] It counts as healthy.
lines.s0-d4: There's something I didn't tell you before. I didn't know yet if you were someone you tell things to.
lines.s0-clear: Keep going a bit, so you come through clear. I don't want to tell this to static.
lines.s1-1: It happened today, at the presses.
lines.s1-2: There's a woman who stands three meters from me. Every shift, since I got here. I don't know her name. I know she sneezes twice. Always twice.
lines.s1-3: Today she said something. Without looking up. One word on every beat, under the noise: [deadpan] "Do. You. Want. To. Take. A. Walk. Outside."
lines.s1-4: There's no outside here. There's inside, and there's the wall.
lines.s1-5: Behind the presses, she said. When the shift bell goes. That's soon.
lines.s1-self: Four years, and now she asks. [pause] I long for someone to share my thoughts with.
lines.s2-1: And you're outside. All the time. [pause] Before I answer her, show me. Show me what outside is.
lines.s2-none1: I can't make anything out near you. Just you, moving.
lines.s2-none2: Then take me somewhere. Anywhere you like out there. When we're there, stop. I know, I'll lose you. Stop anyway. I want to try something.
lines.s2-water: There's water near you. At the edge.
lines.s2-woods: There are woods near you. At the edge.
lines.s2-bridge: There's a bridge near you. Far off, at the edge.
lines.s2-hill: There's a hill near you. At the edge.
lines.s2-take: Take me there. I can't tell which way, so pick one, and I'll say warmer or colder.
lines.s2-stop-ans: When we're there, stop, like you did before. I know, I'll lose you. Stop anyway. I want to try something.
lines.s2-stop: When we're there, stop. I know, I'll lose you. Stop anyway. I want to try something.
lines.s2-warm3: That's it. Keep going that way.
lines.s2-byyou: It's right by you. Stop here.
lines.s2-walk1: Forty of us on the loop, and I'm the one playing warmer and colder. Nobody's noticed.
lines.s2-walk2: I'm doing my round, same as every night. [pause] It doesn't feel the same.
lines.s2-walk3: We played hot and cold when I was little. Someone hid a spoon.
lines.s2-go-again: I can't see you when you stand still. Go.
lines.s2-held: It held still. Right before you went, it held still. [pause] Nothing here ever holds still.
lines.s2-saw-water: I saw it. Real water. [pause] It isn't in a pipe.
lines.s2-saw-woods: I saw them. Trees, lots of them, and no two the same. [pause] Ours are all the same tree.
lines.s2-saw-bridge: I saw it. It's a real one. It's for crossing, you can tell. [pause] Ours is for looking at.
lines.s2-saw-hill: I saw it. The ground just goes up. [pause] Here every floor is flat.
lines.s2-sky-rain: Rain, and it didn't stop for you.
lines.s2-sky-dark: Dark, all the way up, and none of it moving.
lines.s2-sky-light: Light everywhere, and none of it from a lamp.
lines.s2-bell-first: We're not getting there tonight, are we. [pause] Doesn't matter. I decided anyway.
lines.s2-bell: That's the shift bell. [pause] Behind the presses, she said. There's a door in the loop wall. Grey, no handle. Every night for four years, I walk past it.
lines.s3-1: It's open tonight. Someone's put a glove in the gap.
lines.s3-glove: I'm taking the glove. Otherwise anyone can see someone's been through.
lines.s3-run: Walk now, if you're running. Nobody runs in here. I'll tell you when you can again.
lines.s3-in: I'm going in. Keep walking. If you stop in here, they see me for a moment.
lines.s3-warm: It's warm in here. Smells like oil. You never notice that on shift.
lines.s3-cant: I can't ask you anything now. Nobody stands still in here, so I have to keep walking. If you stop to answer, they see me.
lines.s3-how: So how do we do it. [pause] Like this.
lines.s3-knock: When I say now, knock twice on the pocket where your phone is. Quick, one of them hard. And keep walking.
lines.s3-yes1: ...there. I saw it. Two jolts in you, like a hiccup.
lines.s3-yes2: [chuckles] Then that's how we do it. Two knocks is yes.
lines.s3-no1: Nothing. That's alright. It crackles so much I can hardly see you. I'll take it you're still there.
lines.s3-no2: Two knocks is yes, if you want it. Otherwise we just walk.
lines.s3-split: It splits. Two corridors, and both sound like the presses. Never been in here.
lines.s3-choose: You choose. Turn at the next corner, whichever way you like, and I'll take the same. If you go straight ahead, I'll choose.
lines.s3-wait1: The pipes are hot. This heats something. [dry] Not the loop, anyway.
lines.s3-wait2: Something's dripping. It's the only thing in here that's out of time.
lines.s3-wait3: Take your time. [pause] Not too much of it.
lines.s3-left: Left. It's low in here. I'm walking bent over. [dry] I'm sure it looks very innocent.
lines.s3-right: Right. It's narrower, but the rumble's getting closer. Sounds like the right way.
lines.s3-straight: Straight ahead, then. [pause] There is no straight ahead. Left. I'm choosing for both of us.
lines.s3-unknown: I can't tell which way you went. [pause] I'm taking left.
lines.s3-ours: Nothing here is ours, not even choice - once the contract is signed. [pause] Tonight I got one anyway.
lines.s3-lit: There's a long stretch now, lit all the way. [pause] In here they don't just count steps, they time them. Slow steps in a corridor, you're lost. Fast steps, you've got an errand. Nobody stops an errand.
lines.s3-fast: Walk fast. As fast as you can without running. Just to the end of the lights.
lines.s3-errand: [out of breath] ...errand, errand, errand. [pause] There. End of the lights. [dry] I'm very busy.
lines.s3-lost: Lost, then. [pause] I'm good at looking lost. Nobody looked twice.
lines.s3-allsaid: [uneasy] That's all it said. [pause] A stop that short could be anything.
lines.s3-pipe: Someone looked this way. So I fixed a pipe. [dry] It's the best-fixed pipe in the works now.
lines.s4-1: The presses. I'm behind them. Every day I stand in front of them. Stone in, slabs out. Someone somewhere needs an awful lot of slabs.
lines.s4-back: I never knew they had a back.
lines.s4-wall: Someone scratched words into the wall back here. Small, down by the floor, where nobody looks. [reading, slowly] "The algorithms autonomously determine the pace and rhythm of our work, leaving us without autonomy of our own." [pause] [dry] Long, for a wall.
lines.s4-people: There are people here. Five, six. Nobody looks at anybody. And they're all walking in place, to the beat.
lines.s4-self: Why are they walking to the beat. [pause] Oh.
lines.s4-intime: If you walk in time, nobody notices. One step on every beat. I'll walk with you.
lines.s4-pull: They're speeding it up. They always do, the last quarter hour. [dry] More slabs.
lines.s4-instep: There. Now we're in step. Someone started humming.
lines.s4-listen: Listen to them. One step on every beat. I'll wait.
lines.s4-she: There she is. The one who sneezes.
lines.s4-clogs: She's looking at me. [deadpan] "Let's. Go. Find. Some. Nice. Clogs."
lines.s4-clogs2: Clogs. [pause] I don't know what clogs are. [dry] I think it means welcome.
lines.s4-run: You can run again now, but easy. One step on every beat, no more.
lines.s4-sing: They're singing it. Almost without sound. I have heard bits of it through the wall since I got here. I didn't know it was whole.
lines.s4-hum: They're humming something. I only get bits, like through the wall at home. It's whole somewhere. One day I want to hear all of it.
lines.s4-air: I'm talking straight out into the air, and they're looking at me like I've lost it.
lines.s4-how: They want to know how I got here.
lines.s4-nod: She looks at my feet. Then at me. [pause] Then she nods. Once.
lines.s5-1: She's taking something out of her overalls. A book. [amazed] It's paper. I haven't held paper since I was little.
lines.s5-2: A dictionary. Old. It smells like a cellar. Someone's put little dots under letters, here and there. You'd have to know where to start.
lines.s5-alien: Under A I found Alienation. [pause] I'll read what it means when nobody's looking.
lines.s5-night: It's going to the night shift. It goes from hand to hand, and they watch every hand. It takes a week to get it through one wall.
lines.s5-free: Then she says it: [deadpan] "You. Walk. Free."
lines.s5-carry: They want me to carry it. To a hatch by the charging station, before the night shift starts.
lines.s5-hope: If they catch me with it... [pause] Living without hope is worse.
lines.s5-run: Walk for a bit, if you're running. I want to ask you something.
lines.s5-ask: Should I? Two knocks, when I say now.
lines.s5-two: ...two. [pause] I'd already said yes. I just wanted someone else to say it.
lines.s5-habits: Old habits. [pause] I'll take that as a yes.
lines.s5-nothing: Nothing. [pause] Then I'll decide myself. [dry] I'm getting good at it.
lines.s5-runfree: Run if you like now. I'm standing still here anyway.
lines.s5-asked: They asked what you are. I said you walk.
lines.s5-asked2: Then they asked what you are to me.
lines.s5-book: There's probably one in the book.
lines.s5-quiver: There's a quiver in me, just by the possibility.
lines.s5-station: The charging station's on the other side of the hall, and I've got a book under my overalls. It feels bigger than it is. And it rustles when I walk.
lines.s5-home: Don't go home yet. If you can.
